newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-FERGUSON WAS OFFERED ENGLAND JOB, SAYS PAPER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FERGUSON WAS OFFERED ENGLAND JOB, SAYS PAPER.

text.p: Manchester United's Scottish manager Alex Ferguson was offered the job of England coach before it was given to Glenn Hoddle, Britain's Sun newspaper reported on Saturday.

"I was offered the England job after Terry Venables left. I turned it down in favour of staying with United," the newspaper quoted Ferguson as writing in a new book about his career. "However, that is water under the bridge now.
"Not even the European Cup defeat in the semifinal (last season) has made me regret my decision."
Hoddle took over from Venables after last year's European championship finals in England.
